title: objectql `having` answers an array in the equality slot by JS coercion (`having: { total: [5] }` is true) — the one face ruling 乙 closes "for every driver at once" that no gate reaches
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site.** Measured by the at-tier contract review of PR #19882 (record `5808368753`, ①.10), filed by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_019c3Hi6ZMU1p6m6aA6Bz45d`) as remedy (a) of that record. Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's.
Hand that acts: the lane triage routes this to (the landing is `packages/objectql`), in one claim, after PR #19882 lands.
Dedupe (including closed): `having filter array comparand implicit equality applyHaving aggregate having ungated` → 11 hits. The open ones are #19888 (the analytics normalizer, a different face) and #19757 (this ruling's own card). Closed #7158, #6520 and #5905 are earlier `having` gates for other operators. None covers the equality-slot array.

## The defect

Ruling 乙 on #19757 (`5793368540`): an array in the implicit-equality slot is refused at the shared comparand-shape face 「for every driver at once」. PR #19882 gates `where` (`engine.ts` at its head `:866`, `:939`) and `aggregations[i].filter` (`:14776`), but hands `ast.having` to `applyHaving` ungated (`:14885`, `:14929`).

`packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts:357-363` (at `origin/main` at review time) sends an array condition into the implicit-equality arm `value == condition`, and the `$eq` arm compares with `!=` (`:396`). By JS coercion `5 == [5]` and `'a' == ['a']` are both true. So `having: { total: [5] }` still **answers**, on every driver, where the ruling says the shape is refused.

`compile-surfaces.md` marks this half-face as having no conformance table, so no gate goes red for it.

## Remedy shape (for the implementing round to confirm)

Route `ast.having` through the same shared comparand-shape face the engine already applies to `where` and `aggregations[i].filter`, with the same `INVALID_FILTER` / `400` envelope and the same remedy text. Pin: `having: { total: [5] }` and `having: { total: { $eq: [5] } }` are refused, scalars pass.
